Messages.Author: Hans Jorgen Pedersen
Messages.Body:
I've just finished a game of Jyhad with my brother, and 2 specific questions
arose:
When exactly are you allowed to tap a card that gives extra cards?

When would it be allowed to tap the Book of Nod and The Barrens?

To me it seems a bit unfair if someone could use these cards in the middle
of combat or a vote.

Also:
Can a minion use the same strike CARD twice in a round?

Would it be legal to use Fake out to get to long range and then:
use Thrown Sewer lid as the strike and THEN (point coming up)
use a blur card (thus gaining 1 additional strike at long range)
and then play ANOTHER sewer lid (total damage: 6!)
Is a minion allowed to play the same strike card twice in a fight?
there seem to be no rule against it in the rulebook
(only stuff about reaction/modifier cards).

Regards
Simon Pedersen

PS: Thanks for all the replies about Tremere - expect a deck posting soon.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Hans Jorgen Pedersen <dkdf...@inet.uni-c.dk> wrote:
>When exactly are you allowed to tap a card that gives extra cards?
>When would it be allowed to tap the Book of Nod and The Barrens?

As a rule of thumb, you can use such a card whenever you would be able
to play a card (and you would then be able to play something). For example,
if your minion is blocking, you can see what the acting minion's strike
is, then use Barrens, then play a strike.

>To me it seems a bit unfair if someone could use these cards in the middle
>of combat or a vote.

Well, we consider it perfectly acceptable.

>Can a minion use the same strike CARD twice in a round?

You can't use the same actual combat card twice in a round, no. But you could
use more than one copy of a card, given the right number of strikes, and could
use the same weapon repeatedly, for example.

>Would it be legal to use Fake out to get to long range and then:
>use Thrown Sewer lid as the strike and THEN (point coming up)
>use a blur card (thus gaining 1 additional strike at long range)
>and then play ANOTHER sewer lid (total damage: 6!)

This works just fine.

Messages.Author: Jerry Jackson
Messages.Body:
In article <8042776...@inet.uni-c.dk> dkdf...@inet.uni-c.dk (Hans Jorgen Pedersen) writes:
>From: dkdf...@inet.uni-c.dk (Hans Jorgen Pedersen)
>Subject: Book of Nod/Strikes?
>Date: Tue, 27 Jun 1995 18:27:11 GMT

>I've just finished a game of Jyhad with my brother, and 2 specific questions
>arose:

>When exactly are you allowed to tap a card that gives extra cards?

>When would it be allowed to tap the Book of Nod and The Barrens?

>To me it seems a bit unfair if someone could use these cards in the middle

>of combat or a vote.

It may seem unfair but it is legal. The Book of Nod and Barrens can be tapped
anytime. However, before cards can be played, the person must discard to the
proper hand size.

>Also:

>Can a minion use the same strike CARD twice in a round?

Yes, but only one addition strike card.

>Would it be legal to use Fake out to get to long range and then:
>use Thrown Sewer lid as the strike and THEN (point coming up)
>use a blur card (thus gaining 1 additional strike at long range)
>and then play ANOTHER sewer lid (total damage: 6!)

>Is a minion allowed to play the same strike card twice in a fight?
>there seem to be no rule against it in the rulebook
>(only stuff about reaction/modifier cards).

This is perfectly legal. If he had another additional strike, he could chuck
anonter sewer lid at you, doing a total of 9 damage. (Imagine this second
round, chucking 3 Well Aimed Cars: Ouch!)

>Regards
> Simon Pedersen

>PS: Thanks for all the replies about Tremere - expect a deck posting soon.

With this in mind, you can Blur those Thefts of Viteas, Cauldrons, and Blood
Furies.

you have to have two of that card. I once had Anvil manuever to
long range in the second round, throw a sewer lid, blur and then
throw a second lid and with his 2nd strike from the blur, throw a
well aimed car... Ouch... Lucretia was not happy.
